name: lamega.com.co
body: Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 page has no title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.
summary: www.lamega.com.co scores 63 out of 100 (D). 10 checks fail now, 17 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Google consent message was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (11 requests), Microsoft Clarity (4 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies _ga_YQG97TCNX7, _ga,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 1 page has no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example .sw-reels-prev and .sw-reels-next. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /top20, /actualidad/, for example .np__soundbadge_offair and .np__sound_badge_item:nth-child(2) > .np__sound_badge_item_item > .np__card_info_btn[aria-label="Play"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "No consentir" and reloading, Google Ads (12 requests), Microsoft Clarity (4 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: 14 pages ask search engines not to index it
fix.evidence: /actualidad/feid-megaland-2026 (noindex, nofollow, max-video-preview:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1), /actualidad/aria-vega-en-megaland-2026 (noindex, nofollow, max-video-preview:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1),…
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

works.title: Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 327 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
